eyebrow: The statistical test, last and tiered separately
code:
@pytest.mark.statistical
def test_ghz_measurement_distribution():
  sim = AerSimulator(seed_simulator=42)
  counts = sim.run(qc, shots=1024)...
  k = counts.get("000", 0)
  z = (k/1024 - 0.5) / sqrt(.5*.5/1024)
  assert abs(z) < 2.58
caption: The one test that can occasionally fail by chance even on correct code — which is why it carries an explicit confidence threshold.
